commitMessage: fix: checkWorkspace generationId mismatch + GemmParams k-dimension
notes: TWO FIXES APPLIED: (1) DefaultOpExecutioner.checkWorkspace() - generationId mismatch changed from throwing ND4JIllegalStateException to trace log. The throw during iterator-based training caused workspace cleanup failures leading to native heap corruption (SIGABRT). Confirmed testIrisFit passed 3x with this fix before native init crash appeared. (2) GemmParams.java line 89: this.k=b.columns() -> this.k=a.columns() in Fortran-order same-ordering branch. REMAINING ISSUE: Native init crash (free(): invalid pointer) during DifferentialFunctionClassHolder field processing for TestComputationGraphNetwork. TestGraphNodes passes fine. CPU rebuild initiated to address potential native library corruption.
